targetAudience: High-intent owners of fine jewelry, natural diamonds, gold, and luxury watches in 15 named metro markets who are searching Google or Performance Max for a trustworthy way to sell an item or borrow against it. Visitors expect a premium, professional local-office experience, an immediate first step, and a clear no-obligation path.
icp: An adult luxury-asset owner near a Diamond Banc office who wants to understand an item's value and may choose either a direct sale or a jewelry equity loan. They value expert handling, privacy, speed, trusted third-party proof, and the option to meet a local market director. The page should not target retail jewelry shoppers, pawnshop-experience seekers, or owners of unsupported items.
productsServicesInScope: Selling natural diamonds, engagement rings, and fine jewelry
Selling Rolex and other accepted Swiss luxury watches
Selling gold, platinum, and precious-metal jewelry
Jewelry equity loans as an alternative to selling
Customer's embedded AI appraisal widget for an instant initial quote
Appointments and local-office service in each of the 15 named markets
productsServicesOutOfScope: Retail jewelry or watch sales to consumers
Guaranteed valuations, loan amounts, or returns
Any replacement or reimplementation of the customer-owned appraisal widget
qualificationCriteria: Visitor owns an accepted luxury asset and submits the customer-owned appraisal widget or calls the page's market phone number
The customer widget and Salesforce routing remain the source of truth for lead qualification and distribution
disqualificationCriteria: Unsupported assets, including lab-grown diamonds as standalone stones
Requests for guaranteed value or loan terms
geo: Fifteen localized paid-traffic routes: Tampa, Orlando, Coral Gables, Aventura, Boca Raton, West Palm Beach, Sarasota, Nashville, Atlanta, Roswell, Scottsdale, Beverly Hills, St. Louis, Columbia, and Kansas City. Each route uses its task-specified city name, URL slug, local-office reference, and source phone number.
conversionGoal: Primary conversion is a successful submission through Diamond Banc's existing embedded AI appraisal widget, which captures name, phone, email, ZIP code, and an item photo and routes natively to Salesforce. Secondary conversion is a qualified phone call to the exact market-specific number supplied in the build task. The nationwide root page must remain unchanged and live throughout the work.
offerPositioning: A premium, no-obligation way to discover what a valuable item may be worth, with two possible outcomes from one inquiry: sell the item or keep it and borrow against it. Lead with the instant quote and local-office convenience, then support the decision with Diamond Banc's 5 out of 5 reputation, 10,000+ combined reviews, A+ BBB rating, experienced experts, and third-generation-jeweler heritage.
valueProposition: Diamond Banc combines an instant online appraisal step with experienced local experts, a national reputation, and the flexibility to sell or borrow using the same inquiry.
keyMessaging: Use the existing nationwide page's approved content framework and real Diamond Banc photography. Localize the hero as Diamond Banc plus the market name, make the nearby-office path explicit, preserve the sell-or-borrow balance, and keep copy conservative for financial-services advertising. Use 'experienced experts' or accurate GIA-accredited terminology for people, never 'GIA-certified gemologists.'
usp: One premium inquiry gives the visitor an instant initial quote plus access to a local Diamond Banc office, with the option to sell or borrow and no obligation to accept an offer.
requiredSections: hero and embedded AI appraisal widget
trust bar with 5 out of 5 reputation, 10,000+ reviews, A+ BBB rating, and local-office scale
primaryCTA: Get my free quote, scrolling to the existing embedded AI appraisal widget
secondaryCTA: Call the exact market-specific source phone number supplied in the task for the current route
trafficSource: Google Search and Performance Max campaigns segmented by the 15 named markets. Visitors arrive with active selling, valuation, Rolex, watch, diamond, gold, jewelry, or jewelry-loan intent and need route-level message match.
existingSiteAudit: quote.diamondbanc.com is an active, Git-linked Next.js landing page serving nationwide paid traffic. It already contains the approved premium visual system, customer-owned appraisal widget, CTM universal script, GTM container, Mega site registration, Meta Pixel, real Diamond Banc product and team photography, and an approved content framework. The new work must add 15 route paths inside the same repository without changing the nationwide root route or its instrumentation. The main marketing site currently returns an origin-level 404 to this environment, so the live quote page, current repository, task input, customer memory, and meeting summaries are the authoritative build references. Meeting context was ingested through the customer meetings source, including the August 13 customer feedback summary.
